### 1. Project

REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL: ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES
Ref HC-ARTHUR-RFP · Issued 2026-10-12 · Closes 2026-10-30 · Contact Project manager, pm@example.com

Hale Capital intends to extend Warehouse (Class 7b) and Mezzanine office (Class 5) at 145-151 Arthur St, Homebush West NSW (Strathfield).

| Project | Detail |
|---|---|
| Building | Warehouse: Class 7b, 2,135 m² GFA; Mezzanine office: Class 5, 215 m² GFA |
| Quantities | Site 31,720 m² · Gross floor area to be confirmed |
| Planning pathway | Development application (DA) |
| Procurement | Traditional lump sum |
| Site conditions | Work to an existing building; Parts with different NCC classes; Building over or next to a water authority asset; Existing on-site detention to keep or modify; Use generates heavy vehicle movements |
| Information provided | 12 current documents in the project register, listed in the issue record |

### 2. Your role

Lead design consultant: you coordinate the consultants and integrate their work into your documents. You are not responsible for the accuracy of their work. The client engages the other consultants directly: Structural (to be appointed), Civil (to be appointed), Traffic (to be appointed), Town Planner (to be appointed).

### 3. Scope by stage

Price each stage that applies. Each stage ends at client sign-off, and that design is the basis for later stages (section 6).

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off | Pricing |
|---|---|---|
| Concept | Site inspection; review of existing information and brief gaps; up to 2 options; preferred concept; area schedule; check against budget | Lump sum |
| Schematic design | Preferred scheme resolved for planning and the cost plan; outline materials and systems; pre-application meeting where the pathway has one | Lump sum |
| Planning approval | Architectural drawings and input to the Statement of Environmental Effects: one preliminary and one final issue; lodged by others | Lump sum |
| Planning response | Authority information requests and design changes during assessment; actual time at R3 rates up to 20 hours | Time to the ceiling |
| Design development | Coordinated design to the approval and consent conditions; finishes and typical details; BCA strategy with the BCA consultant | Lump sum |
| Interiors | Interior layouts, finishes and joinery for the base building and common areas | Lump sum |
| Tender documents | Documents complete enough to price as a lump sum: drawings, schedules and specification; one tender issue. You hold the whole architectural design. | Lump sum |
| Bidding | Tenderer questions and addenda; actual time at R3 rates up to 40 hours | Time to the ceiling |
| For-construction documents | Negotiated changes incorporated; non-typical details; one for-construction issue and one construction certificate issue; design certification for the construction certificate. You hold the whole architectural design. | Lump sum |

Price these separately; they are not in the base fee.

| Option | Deliverable | Why it is optional |
|---|---|---|
| Design support during construction | 6 site inspections; RFIs; shop drawing review; practical completion and defects inspections | Later stage; the client may commission it |
| Contract administration | Superintendent or contract administrator under the construction contract: progress claims and variations assessed, practical completion and defects certification | Price as an option: the client has not decided who administers the construction contract. |

### 4. Allowances

Price exactly these. Work beyond an allowance needs a written instruction (section 6) and is then charged at your R3 rates.

| Item | Allowance | Item | Allowance |

| Design meetings | 4 per stage, online or in person | Concept options | 2 |
| Client presentations | 2 | Working 3D views | 1 |
| Issues per stage | 1 draft and 1 final | Site visits, design stages | 2 |
| QS cost plan reviews | 3, at schematic, design development and pre-tender | BIM level of detail | LOD 300 |
| Drawing sheets at planning | 12, indicative; list them in R2 | Planning response ceiling | 20 hours |
| Bidding ceiling | 40 hours | Construction site inspections | 6 |

### 6. Terms

- Engagement is under AS 4122-2010 as amended by the client's special conditions (attached). Your own terms and conditions do not apply; list any change you propose to the agreement in R6.
- Only a written instruction from the client's representative authorises a change in scope, work beyond an allowance or a change in fee, under the agreement. Work beyond an allowance without that instruction is not paid.
- Each stage ends at client sign-off, and the signed-off design is the baseline for later stages. Design development within the brief is not a variation; a change the client asks for after sign-off is assessed under the agreement.
- Correcting your own errors or omissions, and coordinating your work with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Invoice monthly against stage progress; payment within 30 days. Payment does not depend on an authority approval.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager, pm@example.com by 2026-10-23. Answers are issued to every tenderer as numbered addenda.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Team 20% · Methodology and program 10% · Compliance with the returnable schedules 10%. Lowest price does not automatically win.

R2 Deliverables list: For each deliverable: format, stage, review rounds, who prepares it and who receives it. Say whether editable source files are included and what reliance others may place on them. Drawing list: the sheets you expect at planning, tender and construction, with titles.
R3 Hourly rates: Rates excl. GST, used only for work authorised in writing beyond the allowances. Roles: Principal or Director · Associate or Senior architect · Project architect · Architect · Graduate or Technician · Interior designer · Administration.
R4 Team: Named lead and their availability by stage, with % time; subconsultants and their roles. Resources must match the program in R7. Named director, project lead and project architect, with registration numbers.
R5 Experience: Two or three comparable projects in the last five years, each with a referee. Choose projects of the same use and work type.
R6 Departures: Each departure from sections 3 to 6 and from the agreement: the clause or item, the change you propose and its effect on fee and time; or write "nil". Departures are evaluated. A general exclusion or qualification not listed here is treated as non-compliant.
R7 Program: Weeks by stage against the durations given, separating your working time, authority assessment time and the dates you need inputs from others.
R8 Insurance and compliance: Professional indemnity $20 million and public liability $20 million, with insurer and expiry; workers compensation; a quality, safety and environmental management system (certified to ISO 9001, 45001 and 14001, or an equivalent system you describe); conflicts of interest.
R9 Reimbursables: "Included in the fee" (preferred), or each item with its rate.

### Before issue — resolve or accept

**Rules await owner review**: The architectural services rules are a draft. Drafting and editing work; issue stays blocked until the owner marks them reviewed.

**Blocks issue — Gross floor area: sources disagree (2135 vs 2895)**: Set the one figure every firm prices from.

**Unallocated: Façade performance certification (NCC Part F3)**: Excluded from this RFP, but the project has no façade engineer package. Add one or name who does it.

**Unallocated: Performance solutions: fire, access, weatherproofing**: Excluded from this RFP, but the project has no fire and access engineers package. Add one or name who does it.

**Live institutional or industrial site: not established**: Left out until confirmed: Staged access, temporary services and occupation design inputs agreed with the operator.

**Community consultation required: not established**: Priced on a printed assumption until confirmed: Community consultation.

**Connecting with Country input required: not established**: Priced on a printed assumption until confirmed: Connecting with Country input with the First Nations consultant.

**Green Star or NABERS target set: not established**: Priced on a printed assumption until confirmed: Green Star or NABERS documentation.
